name: button
title: Button
description: Triggers an action. Native button with solid, line, ghost and danger variants.
a11y: Native <button>: Enter and Space activate, Tab focuses.
loading sets aria-busy and blocks clicks while keeping the label.
asChild renders a link without losing link semantics.

props.name: variant
props.description: Default `solid`: the one main action per view. `line` for the rest, `ghost` for inline links, `danger` for destructive.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default), `sm` for dense toolbars and table rows, or `lg` for prominent calls to action. Same heights as Input and Select.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner, sets `aria-busy` and ignores clicks. The label stays so the width does not jump.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child element (a link, a router link) with the button styles instead of a `<button>`. With `disabled` the link gets `aria-disabled`, leaves the tab order and ignores clicks.

usage: import {Button} from '@monoline/react';
